cohort: 30 postpartum hemorrhage cases and 56 matched controls from a cohort of >60,000 participants in a single institution's perinatal repository
finding: Agnostic proteomic profiling identified 77 differentially abundant proteins in maternal plasma of postpartum hemorrhage cases compared to controls, suggesting potential predictive biomarkers.
mod_finding: Maternal plasma samples were analyzed from women who had vaginal or cesarean deliveries, revealing differentially abundant proteins between controls and postpartum hemorrhage cases, suggesting potential biomarkers for predicting postpartum hemorrhage.
